nom: Peach Slices Snail Rescue Intensive Serum

avis.texte: My skin is very sensitive and finding a new moisturizer is difficult. This serum has given me no issues after a month of use, and I'm excited to see how it holds up in the harsh winters. I'm using this product multiple times a day, my skins been so glowy and clear, I want to order larger bottles!

My wife and I have gone through like 10 bottles of this. We both love it. She has combo skin and I have dry skin, and we both have sensitive, reactive skin. This is a great lightweight moisturizer that you can either use on its own if you have combo/oily skin or layer under another, thicker moisturizer if you have dry skin like I do. I also use this under makeup. It's the perfect base. I think it also helps my acne fade faster too. So so good. I buy multiples every time it goes on sale.

I've used a couple serums, including others from Peach and Lily but this one really takes the cake. It's less expensive, moisturizers exceptionally well, and keeps my skin plump and soft. I was concerned at how small the bottle is, but the serum is thick and a little bit goes a long way.
This is a must. It has significantly reduced my redness and helps my skin without drying it out. It also helps with my clear skin.
I personally didn't see any changes with using this serum. For the price point, I don't see it worth it for myself. I think I'll return it. Love the other products in the snail mucin line though!
Love this serum. I use it along with the 2 moisturizers (one w/ green cap during day; one with blue cap at night) as well as the toner. I love this line and it does everythjng I need.

Bought this to try out from seeing this all over Social Media, gave it a shot for a month and havnt really noticed a big difference in the "hydrating" properties. Im use to using The Inkey List Hyaluronic Acid Serum and wanted to try this to see if theres a difference in my skin. Honestly I like the Hyaluronic Acid Serum better and its less expensive. I will say the Snail Rescue Serum didnt cause any rash or breakouts but it does leave a tacky like feeling to your skin vs the Hyaluronic Acid sinks right in, dosnt leave a "film" and makes the skin immediately feel baby smooth. Ill stick to my original serum.
Love this snail mucin. for all girlies struggling with acne and hydration, it does wonders for preventing scarring to face
This product works great to moisturize, however I am not sure if it is worth its price for the level of moisturization it provides.

I have noticed, compared to other products a little goes a long way, compared to ordinary serums. I noticed a difference after day one. I'm 40 and my skin changed overnight. Nothing was working that I had before, so totally had to switch it up. So glad I found these products! I did use a sample of peach & lily glass serum and it was amazing (owned by same company/woman, and created by same woman)!!!! It's just a little out of my budget, but this one is very comparable!!!! No fragrance either which fabulous!!! I used Google Gemini to compare peach slices ingredients against other brands and these products came out on top. I already notice my hormonal acne going away, dark spots and it's keep acne at bay, even though only been using about 3 days now. No joke. No lie.
Very small and does hydrate but not sure if it is better than the glass skin serum i normally use
Not sticky, absorbs quickly, too soon to see a difference but no complaints thus far
I started using this a few months ago. This was a restock and has become my new favorite serum. Lightweight, goes on smooth and doesn't leave my skin tacky feeling. Feels great under moisturizer.
I used the Peach & Lily glass skin and really liked it… but wanted something at a smaller price point. This delivers clear skin & absorbs well, at a great price!
Did not work well for me personally but love the formula! It's very light and can work for other folks. I have very dry, sensitive eczema prone skin with redness

avis.titre: Has made a huge difference in my skin
avis.texte: I bought a holiday kit that had serum, cleanser, toner, and moisturizer. I was amazed at the difference it made in my skin in a short time. I've reordered and will use this forever. It has cleared up my acne when nothing else would, and believe me, I have tried everything! I wear the serum evry day under their moisturizer, before sunscreen and foundation. It's very light and non sticky, and with their moisturizer, keeps my skin from being greasy and oily, which is a feat. But it also clears up skin and keeps it from breaking out again. Really the best I've found at any price.
I purchased this to help my rosacea sometimes I apply when I get redness but these products does exactly nothing Sad

This serum feels very gentle and clean on the skin. It is not harsh or stripping at all and I have sensitive skin so it is perfect. The only complaint I have is its smaller size and how you have to squeeze the serum out, but this is my own personal opinion, but nothing wrong with the formula.
I love the texture and how hydrated it leaves my skin feeling. My skin looks so plump and hydrated every time
This is so light and lovely feeling on the face, it cleared up my breakout spots after 2 weeks!

I used to use hylaronic acid but found that it would sometimes make me break out and could be drying to my skin. Love this serum. It hydrated my skin without being heavy and without giving me pimples. Postpartum I have had very hormonal sensitive skin. Love this serum.

I've been using this product every night for about 2. 5 weeks, I absolutely love the results so far, I've noticed how smooth and hydrated my skin is. Can't wait to continue to use this to see what other changes will happen, I'm going to definitely reorder!

This serum is so hydrating!! Helps prevent and get rid of acne! would recommend if you have minor/moderate acne( a few to no pimples) and not severe acne. Also, before you buy this pls make sure you are NOT allergic to dust mites and make sure your current skincare routine can be layered with this serum containing snail mucin. Some skin care products do not mix well with snail mucin leading to further irration and breakouts. please do not use this serum if you are currently using harsh exfoliants or acids like AHAs (alpha-hydroxy acids) and BHAs (beta-hydroxy acids), as well as strong retinoids and Vitamin C.

This product is great no smell dries on fast and absorbs into the skin fast.
I've been using this serum for a month and can't tell if it's doing anything. It doesn't feel as hydrating as other formulas.

this saved my skin is kind of like a gel like consistancy, I got the snail mucin set and all of the products I love. I tried the acne set from this brand and it didnt do much. These products gave me a glow that isnt a oily.

i was so excited to try this because all the reviews said it cleared their acne. it made my acne WORSE. my whole face broke out. i did not change anything about my skincare routine but add this serum. my face is so red and irritated. i am so sad :(

avis.titre: Best serum for dry acneic skin
avis.texte: I love this serum!it is so lightweight but extremely moisturizing! I love that it isn't sticky, but would be a fantastic makeup primer. I feel like it has helped my acne without drying out my skin. Pair this with the extra moisture snail rescue for a moisturizer and it is amazing! I recommend this to everyone who is struggling with acne but is constantly dry.
Gentle yet exfoliating, and doesn't have a smell which I love!

This is a great serum. I add it to my face as a base. It doesn't cause redness or irritation and I have no issues with breakouts. I have sensitive skin and this keeps my face from having dry skin issues. I think it's helping to reduce signs of aging but I've never used it alone.

avis.titre: Cleared my acne SO fast! Amazing product line!
avis.texte: Im always very weary of the products i use on my face so was skeptical trying this out. I was consistent with using it at first but slowly stopped because i didnt notice a big difference and as soon as i stopped using it my face immediately started breaking out. As soon as i started using it again my acne cleared and ive been consistently using it from july and its now november. I originally started using the toner from this line and loved it! Im slowly switching over to all the products from this line. I couldn't recommend these products enough!!!!

the whole line is truly great. I've switch my whole skin care to this. The cleanser is my daily gentle cleanser, toner so soothing and the serum CHEFS KISS ! The Moisture isn't my fav for my skin type so I'm going to try the deep moisture one. I have high hopes.

avis.titre: Hydrating & Glowing: Snail Rescue Serum is a Skincare Must-H
avis.texte: After trying the Snail Rescue toner and loving the results, I decided to explore more products from the Snail Rescue line. The serum has been a fantastic addition to my routine—it deeply hydrates my skin, leaving it with a smooth, glass-like finish that I absolutely love. My skin feels plump, refreshed, and glowing after each use. The quality of this serum is impressive, especially considering the reasonable price. It's a high-value product that has quickly become a staple in my skincare collection!
This entire line is amazing. But i used the thris serum as a primer under my foundation/bb cream and my foundation went on so smooth. This is going to be my new go to primer
This is a great lightweight snail mucin serum for my combination skin. It hydrates my skin and is a great addition to my skincare routine.

Bought this product about a month ago when it was on sale. I didn't have very many expectations because I've never used anything like it before, but wanted to give it a try after seeing it had good reviews. My skin isn't terrible, but I've fought blemishes since I was a teenager. I've not had a single one since I started using this product, even throughout the hormonal changes of my cycle! And the only change I have made is that I started using this serum! So far, I am happy and will continue to use peach slices, snail rescue for the foreseeable future if my skin continues to stay clear!

It's the right balance in the profit when completing your skin routine. Be sure to include your neck. It's really great product. I've been using them for about a year now. People continue to ask about my skin routine. Highly recommend this line

This has been my go to for breakouts! I love this serum! I bought one at Ulta and then bought a second one! I've paired it with the cleanser and moisturizer! This has been my new attack plan against acne breakouts!

i havent had a breakout since I started using this. feels nice on the skin, i havent used it long enough to notice if my acne scars are fading. my main issue us the packaging. its a squeeze bottle which seems weird for a serum. i have joint pain in my fingers so it can be difficult to squeeze to get the product out sometimes, im also worried about not being able to use all the product due to the bottle and no way to scrape it out, which would be a waste
Easy to use, affordable, and effective. I also need like I have very occasional acne but I do feel like I have it less frequently after starting this line:

I love this serum. I have sensitive skin and have tried alot of skincare and it would always break me out or make my face red. Ever since I started using this brand my skin has been very soft and clear. Will be repurchaseing always!

I have combo dry/oily skin with a bit of redness on my chin area and are clog+acne prone. I tried this because the reviews seemed very positive and I wanted to incorporate something to help my skin texture and hydrate. I tried this for one day and my redness had reduced visibly by the next morning, and my skin didn't seen flaky as it usually was or seem irritated. Its been about a week so far and I haven't broken out or gotten any clogged pores! I would recommend to anyone struggling with some redness or dry/flaky skin. The only reason my review isnt 5 stars is because I want to test this product longer to see the full effects :)
My face feels smoother after using this product for just a few weeks.
Love this serum. It is both calming and moisturizing. Its perfect for an extra boost with a good moisturizer.

I have been fortunate enough to go through my teenage years with little to no hormonal acne, but now I'm pregnant and taking prenatal vitamins with folic acid, which is giving me the worst chin acne that leaves scars. I also needed to find skin care for acne that doesn't have salicylic acid in it because that ingredient isn't safe for baby. I've used peach slices products before and the price point is just awesome, so I wanted to try it again. The snail mucin is just so healing. It cleared up all hormonal acne within a two days of morning and night routines. I'm also using the snail mucin toner before applying this and my skin is fed, has healed, and is so soft. The acne scars are also fading and my skin is returning back to normal! Amazing stuff. 100% recommend. They just need to offer a larger bottle size because I'm already half way finished!

avis.titre: Great for Dry, Sensitive, or Acne Prone Skin!
avis.texte: So far this has been great for an overall reduction of redness on my skin. I also think it has really helped even out my skin's texture, so any lumps or bumps my skin may have before I apply any other products. It is really hydrating too!

I use this (53yrs) on my Tzone and it helps minimize pores/blackheads and oil! The whole line is great! It helps my teenager when he decides to use it! It lasts a long time too! Worth every penny & my skin has never looked better since before puberty!!

avis.titre: Bought to help with eczema  flare
avis.texte: I have used this in the past and didn't see any change but have developed eyelid eczema and know that snail mucinncn encourage healing. It hasn't been very long but it does cool and seem to help with the inflammation on my eyelids.

This product works well on teenage skin sensitivity. Purchased for my daughter after complaints and not being able to find a consistent routine or product that works for her allergy prone skin and sensitivity. After making the switch there has been no turning back. Her skin has never looked better. Even skin tone that is not affected when she has a flare up. Peach and Lily has not disappointed on anything thus far.
Not harsh or irritating, gentle yet effective, it dries nicely and not sticky and helps where needed to clear stubborn blemishes.

avis.titre: Great for sensitive skin and acne
avis.texte: I love the clear texture and it keeps my skin looking vibrant and smooth. I have acne prone skin and since I started using this product a few months ago with the whole set toner and mask, my skin have improve significantly. People will ask me on the street what I use when I use no makeup.

avis.titre: A must have for acne prone skin!
avis.texte: Will always repurchase this serum! It does a great job of helping to clear up my blemishes! It's so gentle and hydrating! I use it in the morning and at night.
Holy grail. Finally found something that cleared my face up. Along with all the other peach slices snail mucin products! Even my cystic acne is gone :sparkles::sparkles::sparkles:
Between this and the toner, my skin cleared up in less than two weeks. My daughter commented that my skin looked amazing. Won't buy any other brands after this.

avis.titre: One of my go to serums
avis.texte: Definitely recommend especially for combination and dry skin.

I honestly expected it to break me out and anticipated having to return it. Imagine my surprise when it immediately cleared my skin! This product has helped clear my acne and left my skin so smooth. Keep in mind its not the most hydrating serum, but I just use one underneath this and then put the snail mucin on top. Highly recommend.

i purchased this not even a week ago & have only been using it at night after the peach slices cleanser & i noticed results within the first two days! any major redness on my face had basically vanished over night!! the only thing i would love is if this product came in a larger size! but overall i have nothing bad to say about this product, i love it :)

Great serum for fine lines and pumping skin. I can see the difference. As for acne, I don't see any difference in reduction. But I like the texture of the serum not sticky and fast absorption, great for oily skin.

I use the Snail Rescue heavier moisturiser and it is awesome on my dry sensitive skin. I don't think the serum was damaging or anything, but i don't think i really needed it in my routine. Kinda felt the same with and without once I was done. I expected it to feel refreshing and supple on my skin, but it was just there pretty much. It's also much more of a gel consistency rather than a liquid

This is great for travel! I do have extremely sensitive skin so I'm not sure if this works well for my skin especially around my forehead. I'm still giving it a try though because the rest of my skin feels great!
Dries to a non sticky finish, that layers nicely with anything. I need a heavier moisturizer over the top of it, but this is a really nice start to my skincare routine!

avis.titre: Great for my acne & eczema prone skin
avis.texte: Love this stuff! O am able to use it without worrying about it causing eczema, while also treating my more acne prone areas! I love it.

avis.titre: It's good for me not great
avis.texte: It's a good product but slightly irritating to my skin personally.
Love this! I have oily skin and this helps add another layer of moisture without being oily or greasy.
The Snail Rescue Intensive Serum is a good serum, but I can get another almost-identical product at a much better price.

After a long day of moving boxes to the house covered with dusts and other pollutants my skin was completely dehydrated my lips were dried and chapped. My skin needed deep hydration. I double cleans, use the hydrating mask, toned and use the intensive serum to hydrate my skin. It was the best treatment for my face.

I took it with me to a vacation in a very sunny place. Helped with my sunburned skin (I would apply it generously and let it absorb), helped my rosacea and some weird skin allergy on my arms. Very soothing.
Love this serum! Helps with acne or uneven texture without scorching your skin. Does not pill and can be worn under makeup.

Absolutely love this. My skin feels so soft and I can actually see a difference in my forehead and the smile lines around my mouth. Everything looks so much softer. I can't wait to use it again. If it continues to work like this you have a customer for life!!

This line has literally made me a believer in product claims again… this does exactly what it says & I'm obsessed with the entire line. I have oily, acne prone, sensitive, skin & this stuff has balanced my skin and makes it feel smooth and comfortable. Just try it.
Love it! I use the whole line of snail rescue and it makes my skin look and feel amazing !

Fantastic product! I love this serum, it goes on so beautifully and sinks into my skin immediately. I've noticed that my skin looks brighter, my pores have shrunk and my skin looks more radiant and feels great!

I have found that using only a small portion of this is much better than not. Too much can be a bit filmy on the skin, but a small bit patted on with wet hands, followed by a moisturizer, does pretty well. While it's good, it isn't a staple in my routine.
Noticed a significant difference on my skin barrier. My skin is hydrated.

avis.titre: Great very sensitive skin. Glass skin effect.
avis.texte: This product is doing wonders for my acne prone, hyperpigmentation skin. It's hydrating but not too much, a gel formula so its not runny. A must try!

Being a month in, my skin is still going through the purging stage, so I like to use this product day & night to help reduce inflamed, red acne, along with the snail toner (at night). I have noticed a difference in my acne. The product leaves my skin feeling a bit sticky, but once moisturizer is applied it becomes less sticky. I have found that my face gets oily/greasy throughout the day, I'm not sure which product in the skin care line causes this. I will continue to include this in my regimen when my acne flares up.
This adds such a nice glow to my face and helps minimize the appearance of my pores
I was skeptical at first but this is entire line is phenomenal
The Snail Mucin Serum is a game changer! I will never go without it again! My skin has never looked better, even during my most hormonal times of the month! :u1F970:
This product has really help with my acne. The best part for me is, when i use it, my acne doesnt look red
This serum has improved my skin and breakouts. I can a visible change in my skin since starting to use this serum.
Not exactly sure what this product is supposed to do, but my skin loves it!
I got this for my daughter who has acne prone skin. She's tried several other serums before but said that this one was the best. It's light, and works really well for oily skin.

I used this as part of my night skincare routine, and it was perfect. The consistency is thick and light-weight. It is refreshing to apply, like applying aloe vera. It kept my dry skin feeling nice and moisturized all night (in tandem with my moisturizer).

I really struggle with finding products that truly add hydration to my skin. This has been a huge help to add moisture and making my skin look and feel more radiant and plump! Loving the snail rescue line!
Have only had it for a short time so it's hard to tell..it.ight need a month or two..feels nice!

I usually feel like it takes at least 6-12 weeks using a new product to make a difference with my skin. This serum is my new absolute favorite thing. I have to stop myself from using it twice a day so I don't run out too quickly. I can ditch my other night serums and just use this with a night cream on top. It does everything it says and gives my skin the glow it's never had.

I love how this feels on my skin - I have dry, rosacea/acne prone skin with hyperpigmentation and have noticed that after using this for a few weeks consistently, my skin feels softer and is not as inflamed. The consistency is gel-like and does not irritate my extremely sensitive skin. I love everything in the snail line and will continue using this!
I use this twice a day and I love it! One of my favorite skin care products. It makes my skin feel so smooth and hydrated.
Helps my redness, makes acne dry up but still moisturizes my skin!
I love this feels so good on the skin and I see a lot of improvement on the skin
This caused small white heads and large red lumps on my cheeks (the only place i used it). As soon as i stopped using it my skin started to heal. Felt nice but my skin did not react well to it.
Like the feel, texture and how smooth is goes on, and absorbs into my skin. I like the results and how it makes my face look and feel. Nice hydration

I have been using the Snail Rescue cleanser, serum and moisturizes for over a week now. I feel the difference in my skin which is now soft and moist. No dry patches at all. This is now my go to trio and I have been recommending it to family and friends. Thank you Peach Slices

This is my first time using this product and it's actually cleared my skin and left it feeling moisturized, which is no small feat in the extremely dry, icy, wind chill conditions of Northern winters.
I've only used this twice as I havnt worked how to include it into my daily face routine. However it dries super fast and I see it being a good face primer before makeup.

the ingredients are great for sensitive skin, it feels really hydrating. however it absorbs into the skin very quickly so you need to use a lot and the bottle is tiny. its very expensive for the size, cant see this lasting me more than a few weeks.
Light weight, good for my oily skin, yhe right amount of moisture for dry weather!
This product is AMAZING!! I have oily and this stuff helps with the oil. I use it morning and night and I am completely obsessed with this entire line!! Wonderful skin care products!!

I'm a huge fan of the entire snail line. I love how hydrating and light this serum is. Tip: when you think you are finished cut the bottle in half to get a couple more applications (just beware of the sharp plastic edges).

I really like this serum....wish it came in a larger bottle with pump action. I really smoothes the texture of my skin....not sure I can afford to continue use because its pretty expensive for the size.

I think that this serum is amazing. Im a skincare girly and i always use my regular routine, but if I forget to put this on for a few days i notice that my skin doesnt look as good as it should. I recommend using on slightly damp skin before u use anything else. Whenever i use this every night, my skin is flawless. They should make a bigger bottle so i dont skip over it so often😄 (I have acne prone skin & combo skin)

I felt the serum was a little too expensive given the size of the product, but it really is worth every penny! this helped calm my acne down and it kept my skin hydrated and smooth. I found that it also lasted me many months before I actually ran out of it. So good!!!
Loving it so far. Was suffering from jawline breakouts and those have cleared up and discoloration is starting to go away too. Nice texture, little to no smell, and leaves face feeling nice.
I use this every night and ive been getting so many compliments on my skin. i have normal to oily skin and i use this with with a mositerizer and wash as a basic routine and love it!!
